description: This file defines the WarningReportingUnit class and its nested Setting class, including JSON serialization, category management, and warning event reporting functionalities within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Main class managing warning reporting categories, controls, and events within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for warning categories, including JSON serialization support.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting::JSON
classes.description: JSON container class for serializing and deserializing WarningReportingUnit::Setting objects.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a warning reporting control for a specific category.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a control from the category list.

methods.name: GetCategories
methods.description: Retrieves the list of category names.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches default and current configuration info for a category.

methods.name: Defaults
methods.description: Gets or sets the default categories configuration in JSON format.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specific identifier and information.

methods.name: UpdateEnabledCategories
methods.description: Updates the enabled categories based on JSON configuration.
